description:
Transfer runes to a recipient address using Runestone OP_RETURN encoding.

Builds a Bitcoin transaction with a Runestone, sends runes to the recipient, and returns remaining runes to the sender Taproot address.

Requires wallet to be unlocked. Amount is in smallest rune units (raw integer).
Uses Unisat indexer to fetch rune UTXOs (UNISAT_API_KEY recommended).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

amount.description: Amount of runes to transfer in smallest unit (integer string, e.g., '1000')

feeRate.description: Fee rate: 'fast' (~10 min), 'medium' (~30 min), 'slow' (~1 hr), or sat/vB number (default: medium)

name: transfer_rune
